ValidationRule.description: Enterprise deals above 2,000,000 must meet all approval conditions before moving to Approved. Only fires on stage transition to Approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(PLS_BM_Deal_Type__c, "Enterprise") && ISPICKVAL(PLS_BM_Stage__c, "Approved") && ISCHANGED(PLS_BM_Stage__c) && PLS_BM_Deal_Value__c > 2000000 && ( PLS_BM_Discount__c > 0.20 || ISPICKVAL(PLS_BM_Risk_Level__c, "High") || ISPICKVAL(PLS_BM_Risk_Level__c, "Critical") || NOT(PLS_BM_Compliance_Approved__c) || ISBLANK(PLS_BM_Contract_Number__c) || ISBLANK(PLS_BM_Contract_Start_Date__c) || PLS_BM_Contract_Start_Date__c < TODAY() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enterprise deals above 2,000,000 must meet all approval conditions before moving to Approved.
